name: XA Delay
description: 22.05 kHz half-rate / BBD hybrid stereo echo with 4 modes (Echo, Ping-Pong, Tape, Dark) and beat-synced subdivisions.

params.name: Mode
params.explanation: Echo topology (ECHO = PS1 stereo, PING = ping-pong, TAPE = multi-head space echo, DARK = deep BBD dub).

params.name: Time
params.explanation: Delay time: 20..700 ms (clicks 0..680), then 1/16..1/4. synced to pedal BPM.

params.name: Fdbk
params.explanation: Repeat feedback (0..95%; saturates safely into warm self-oscillation near max).

params.name: Tone
params.explanation: SPU vIIR / BBD clock darkening on repeats (0 = bright 8.5 kHz SPU, 100 = dark 1.2 kHz BBD).

params.name: Mod
params.explanation: BBD clock warble / chorus modulation depth on repeats (0..100%).

params.name: Grit
params.explanation: PS1 SPU 16-bit RAM saturation and progressive lo-fi repeat grit (0..100%).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Dry/Wet blend (0 = dry, 50 = unity dry + wet, 100 = 100% wet).

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: LATCH: normal toggle. UNLATCH: momentary while held.
